verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents embeddable or customizable checkout or payment components. The only related line says creators can use their personal site instead of the Gumroad storefront, but it does not say payment happens on that site rather than through a redirect to Gumroad's hosted product URLs. Without a documented embed or overlay widget, the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page
